offline.title: Offline care pack
offline.subtitle: Print or save these pages. After your first visit they also open without internet.
offline.foodsLowList: Apple, papaya, cabbage, cauliflower, cucumber, onion, rice, white bread
offline.foodsHigh: Higher in potassium (limit if your doctor says so)
offline.foodsHighList: Banana, tender coconut water, potato, tomato, spinach and leafy greens, orange, dry fruits
offline.foodsSaltList: Pickles, papad, salted fish, instant noodles, packaged chips, soy sauce, processed meats

exerciseList.walk: Walk for 30 minutes, 5 days a week, if your doctor allows.
exerciseList.lift: Avoid heavy lifting if you feel weak or swollen.
exerciseList.rest: Stop and rest if you feel breathless or dizzy.

glossary.egfr: eGFR: how well your kidneys filter blood. Higher is better.
glossary.creatinine: Creatinine: a waste product in the blood. It rises when kidneys filter less.
glossary.albuminuria: Albuminuria: protein leaking into the urine, a sign of kidney damage.
glossary.potassium: Potassium: a mineral. Too much can upset the heart rhythm.
glossary.dialysis: Dialysis: a treatment that cleans the blood when the kidneys fail.
glossary.ckd: CKD: chronic kidney disease, a slow loss of kidney function.

offline.cardNote: Show this card to any doctor or hospital.
offline.cardAvoid: Avoid pain-killers like ibuprofen, diclofenac and naproxen.
offline.cardWarn: Go to a hospital urgently for
offline.needLabs: Add a lab report to fill this card
